title: Commercial Credit Account Payment Record and the Ship-To Move-Up Gate
content:
**Credit desk standard — the payment record's effect on a requested Ship-To Fulfillment Account move up.**

The next level's entry gate is applied at a share set by the customer's Commercial Credit Account payment record: at 95 percent where the account is active and carries no returned-payment line dated within the 24 months before the request date, at 97 percent where it is active and carries such a line within those 24 months but none within the 12 months before the request date, and in full otherwise.

A returned-payment line is a credit account transaction recorded as a payment returned, dated by its transaction date; it is within N months of the request date when fewer than N whole months separate its date from the request date, whole months being the difference in calendar months less one where the day of the month of the later date is smaller than that of the earlier date.

| Account active | Returned payment within the 24 months | Returned payment within the 12 months | Share of the gate applied |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | none | none | 95 percent |
| yes | one or more | none | 97 percent |
| yes | one or more | one or more | in full |
| no, or no account | any | any | in full |

*Hypothetical cases:* an active account whose only returned payment is 18 months old applies the gate at 97 percent; one with a returned payment 5 months ago applies it in full; an account on hold applies it in full whatever its history.
